top_signals.title: ‘AI Renaissance’ in Old Economy Stocks Starting to Get Stretched
top_signals.summary: A brisk rally in industrial stocks this year has defied higher oil prices, rising bond yields and restrictive trade policies, as investors bet on big gains from the artificial intelligence boom. Now signs are emerging the optimism may have gone too far.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Fed Is Not Entire Story for Long-End Bonds, TD’s Brooks Says
top_signals.summary: Molly Brooks, US rates strategist at TD Securities, sees the potential for an “asymmetric risk” to markets from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh’s comments in Jackson Hole next week and explains what she sees driving the recent back up in long-end Treasuries. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Binance says employees questioned in UAE cleared and released
top_signals.summary: Binance’s employees were cleared and released after providing statements to UAE authorities about third-party fund flows through a company client account, a spokesperson told Cointelegraph.
